answer.says: Ramesh, the tea is accepted with gratitude. As for the rice, I see the necessity. I cannot pay you the wage now, for my purse is lighter than your ledger, but I will go to Khan Market this evening. I will return with the rice and the vegetables. You will cook tonight, and I will eat. Do not wait up.
answer.thought: The system of needs bites back. I have the money for the groceries, but not the wage. The state has failed me, and now the household machinery grinds to a halt. I must go out to buy the raw materials of survival, for the kitchen is the only place where the ethical life still functions in this house.
